# A ball's blob shadow on the sand: a flat dark 12-gon, 1.2 m across. Origin at its centre.
new
material new Shadow --base-color 0.5608 0.3412 0.3961 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name Shadow --vertices 12 --radius 0.6 --depth 0.04 --location 0 0 0
scale 1 0.7 1
apply --scale
material assign Shadow
active Shadow
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
select all
shade flat
export shadow.glb
